name: smwmusic-touhou-yumejikuu-phantasmagoria-of-dim-dream-game-over
title: Touhou Yumejikuu ~ Phantasmagoria of Dim. Dream - Game Over
description:
The jingle in Touhou 3: Phantasmagoria of Dim. Dream that plays when you get a game over.

Great for... game over and death themes obviously.

Note:
There's an option to enable or disable the death SFX. By default, it is turned on.
